title: Frigate Viewer
serverUrlHint: Without a scheme, HTTPS is used. Changes connect automatically.
defaultCameraHint: Shown first every time the viewer opens.
doorbellHint: Enter the doorbell's own HTTP/HTTPS address. Pressing its button opens the main camera, even with the viewer closed. Leave empty to disable.
doorbellCredentialsMissing: Save the doorbell's own username and password using Credentials below.
doorbellAuthFailed: Doorbell login failed. Check its credentials and try again.
doorbellUnavailable: Doorbell unreachable. Check that HTTP/HTTPS access is enabled. Retrying automatically.
doorbellUnsupported: This device does not provide doorbell button events. Check the address and firmware, then try again.
doorbellInvalidResponse: Unexpected doorbell response. Check its address and that HTTP/HTTPS access is enabled.
camerasAfterConnect: Cameras appear here once the server connects.
noCamerasFound: No cameras found on this server.
noCamerasSelected: No camera is enabled for the viewer.
noUrlConfigured: Enter the server address in Settings.
invalidUrl: Use an HTTP or HTTPS address without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
invalidResponse: The server answered, but not like Frigate. Check the address.
authFailed: Check your username and password. Frigate's JWT login (port 8971) is not supported: use port 5000 or a Basic Auth proxy.
httpError: The server answered HTTP {status}. Retrying automatically.
streamError: This camera is not sending images right now.
runtimeUnavailable: A private XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is required for camera previews.
snapshotWriteFailed: Could not write the temporary camera image.
keyringFailed: Could not read credentials from the system keyring. Unlock it and try again.
terminalFailed: Could not open a terminal for keyring credentials.
